claim: Hershey ran Super Sweet Adventure, a ticketed pop-up experience and retail store at Tysons Corner Center, slated to close on Labor Day 2026.
quote: The sweets-celebrating attraction -- which consists of both a ticketed experience and a retail store -- is slated to close on Labor Day (Monday, Sept. 7) after staying at the mall for more than four months.
touchpoint: Super Sweet Adventure pop-up experience and retail store

claim: Hershey and Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products announced limited-edition Harry Potter-themed Hershey's milk chocolate bars and Kisses.
quote: The Hershey Company and Warner Bros. Discovery Global Consumer Products announced limited-edition Hershey's milk chocolate bars and Kisses that feature the Wizarding World of Harry Potter.
touchpoint: Harry Potter limited-edition bars and Kisses packaging

claim: Hershey launched ONE Hershey, a unified U.S. commercial operating model across its sweet, salty and protein brands.
quote: By activating our full portfolio as ONE Hershey, we're better positioned to meet consumers wherever they are, create more moments of goodness and lead next generation snacking with speed and purpose.
touchpoint: ONE Hershey unified commercial operating model

claim: Hershey named Amanda Almond President, International, effective 2026-10-12, as part of management changes.
quote: She joins Hershey from Vinarchy, where she served as regional managing director for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, following 12 years in senior regional leadership roles at Bacardi.
